topics.topic: Clarify whether create_app's no-mutation rule covers framework construction and later route behavior
questions: Does this prohibit only durable/domain writes, or all mutation including construction and route registration in an in-memory web-framework object?
Does this describe only the act of constructing the HTTP surface, or also the later behaviour of the routes in that surface, which can create placements and marks?

quotes: None until the surface is served. The health route answers without a token. Every other route checks the token, the project id and the form of its body when it has one, calls one operation of `module:photo_delivery` and turns its refusal into an answer.
Writes a stored image and a placement record when the photo is placed.
judgement.why: The text distinguishes construction, which has no observable effect, from later served-route behavior, which invokes operations whose own state effects are specified.

topics.topic: Clarify whether run_service's read-only rule covers startup side effects and the full request-serving period
questions: Does this prohibit only durable/domain writes, or does it also constrain process, socket, framework and logging state changed while the server is started and served?
Does `run_service` remain read-only only in its own startup code, or must the entire period in which it serves state-changing delivery and mark requests be read-only?

quotes: Calls `public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings`, `public_op:deliverer_api.load_config`, `public_op:deliverer_api.read_token` and `public_op:deliverer_api.create_app` in that order, then serves the surface on the loopback interface and the `port` of the run settings until it is stopped.

None until the surface is served. The health route answers without a token. Every other route checks the token, the project id and the form of its body when it has one, calls one operation of `module:photo_delivery` and turns its refusal into an answer.
Creates at most one placement of a project and content, and the project lock file on first use. After a failed record write a stored image may remain without a record (A3 rule 5).
judgement.why: The operation is explicitly required to create and serve a listening surface, while state-changing requests invoke separately specified photo-delivery operations during that serving period.
